'''Nectarot''' was a [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] that could be purchased on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Shop owner [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] would sometimes send out his slave, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], to purchase some.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
